name: itsa-year-part
title: An Income Tax year, quarter to adjustments
description: A signed-in walk through the first part of Making Tax Digital for Income Tax across a tax year: sign in, take out Resident Pro, pick a business, file a quarterly update for a self-employment business and for a UK property business, then close the year out with the annual submission and its adjustable summary adjustments. This covers the year up to the adjustments step; losses and claims, the tax calculation and the final declaration are not in this recording.

steps.label: Waiting for the developer mode toggle

steps.text: This is a sandbox preview against HMRC's test service, not a live filing.
steps.headline: A sandbox preview
steps.instruction: Read the sandbox notice: this page talks to HMRC's test service and files nothing live.

steps.text: You are already signed in. See the full sign-in walkthrough in our sign-in video.
steps.headline: Already signed in
steps.instruction: Check that the header shows you signed in; if it does not, choose Sign in first.

steps.caption: Making Tax Digital for Income Tax starts from one dashboard.
steps.headline: One dashboard for MTD
steps.instruction: Choose Self Assessment (HMRC, sandbox) on the Activities page.

steps.caption: Type the National Insurance number HMRC asks for.
steps.headline: Enter your NI number
steps.instruction: Enter your National Insurance number.

steps.caption: See the full HMRC access walkthrough in our HMRC authorisation video.
steps.headline: Grant access, faster

steps.label: Waiting for HMRC
steps.caption: HMRC answers with the businesses behind this Self Assessment.
steps.headline: HMRC lists your businesses
steps.instruction: Read the businesses that HMRC lists.

steps.caption: Each business carries an ID.
steps.headline: Note each business ID
steps.instruction: Note the business ID beside each business.

steps.caption: This year has a self-employment and a UK property business.
steps.headline: Two businesses this year
steps.instruction: Choose Go to business details to list both businesses.

steps.caption: Business Details lists every business by type.
steps.headline: List businesses by type
steps.instruction: Choose Go to business details.

steps.caption: This sandbox account holds a self-employment and a property business.
steps.headline: Self-employment and property
steps.instruction: Choose the BUSINESS_AND_PROPERTY test scenario in the Test scenario list.

steps.caption: The same National Insurance number, every business.
steps.headline: Same NI number
steps.instruction: Enter the same National Insurance number.

steps.caption: The scope granted a moment ago still covers this.
steps.headline: Same scope covers this
steps.instruction: Choose Retrieve business details; the permission you gave already covers it.

steps.label: Waiting for HMRC
steps.caption: HMRC answers with both businesses and their IDs.
steps.headline: Both businesses, two IDs
steps.instruction: Read both businesses and their business IDs in the results table.

steps.caption: One quarterly update form per business type, all year.
steps.headline: One form per business
steps.instruction: Note the business type of each row; each type has its own quarterly update form.

steps.caption: First quarter, the self-employment business.
steps.headline: First quarter, self-employment
steps.instruction: Choose Go to file a quarterly update on the Self Assessment dashboard.

steps.caption: This business's ID, from Business Details.
steps.headline: The self-employment ID
steps.instruction: Enter the Business ID that Business Details listed.

steps.caption: The tax year this quarter falls in.
steps.headline: Choose the tax year
steps.instruction: Choose the Tax year of the quarter.

steps.caption: Then the quarter's income and expenses.
steps.headline: Income and expenses
steps.instruction: Enter the quarter's Turnover and the expenses beside it.

steps.caption: File it with HMRC.
steps.headline: File with HMRC
steps.instruction: Choose File quarterly update.

steps.label: Waiting for HMRC
steps.caption: HMRC accepts the period summary.
steps.headline: HMRC accepts the quarter
steps.instruction: Read the result to check that HMRC accepted the period summary.

steps.caption: Same quarter, the UK property business - its own form.
steps.headline: Same quarter, property business
steps.instruction: Choose Go to file a quarterly update again, this time for the UK property business.

steps.caption: The property business's own ID.
steps.headline: The property ID
steps.instruction: Enter the property business ID in Business ID.

steps.caption: Rent received, and the expenses against it.
steps.headline: Rent and expenses
steps.instruction: Enter the Rental income and the Repairs and maintenance for the quarter.

steps.caption: File it with HMRC.
steps.headline: File with HMRC
steps.instruction: Choose File quarterly update.

steps.label: Waiting for HMRC
steps.caption: Both businesses now have this quarter on file.
steps.headline: Both businesses now filed
steps.instruction: Read the result to check that HMRC accepted the property update as well.

steps.caption: HMRC works out a business source adjustable summary from the quarters filed.
steps.headline: HMRC works out a summary
steps.instruction: Choose Go to year-end adjustments on the dashboard, then ask HMRC for a year-end summary of the quarters you filed.

steps.caption: Trigger the summary and read what HMRC calculated.
steps.headline: Trigger HMRC's summary
steps.instruction: Choose Request year-end summary, then read what HMRC calculated.

steps.label: Waiting for HMRC
steps.caption: Turnover, expenses and the net profit HMRC worked out.
steps.headline: Turnover, expenses, net profit
steps.instruction: Read the turnover, expenses and net profit in HMRC's summary.

steps.caption: Change a figure if HMRC's version is wrong, then submit.
steps.headline: Correct a figure
steps.instruction: Edit any figure that HMRC's summary gets wrong, then choose Submit adjustment.

steps.caption: The last year-end step saves the annual submission.
steps.headline: The annual submission
steps.instruction: Choose Go to annual submission on the Self Assessment dashboard.

steps.caption: Load what HMRC already holds for the year.
steps.headline: Load the year so far
steps.instruction: Choose Load annual submission.

steps.caption: Claim the trading income allowance instead of itemised ones.
steps.headline: Claim the trading allowance
steps.instruction: Choose Trading income allowance, then enter the amount you claim.

steps.caption: Save the year's allowances and adjustments.
steps.headline: Save allowances and adjustments
steps.instruction: Choose Save annual submission.

steps.label: Waiting for HMRC
steps.caption: HMRC accepts the annual submission.
steps.headline: HMRC accepts the year
steps.instruction: Read the result to check that HMRC accepted the annual submission.

steps.caption: Saved. This is the record as submitted: its reference, its status and the date.
steps.headline: The record as submitted
steps.instruction: Read the record for its reference, its status and the date.

steps.caption: Every figure you claimed is on the record, ready to keep.
steps.headline: Keep this copy
steps.instruction: Check every figure you claimed in the record and keep your copy.
